findings.title: New subcommand spec'd into the deprecated `orbit change` namespace
findings.recommendation: The spec mandates `orbit change fingerprint <change-name>`, but every `orbit change ...` invocation emits 'Warning: The "orbit change ..." commands are deprecated. Prefer verb-first commands' (src/cli/index.ts:177). A new capability should not be born deprecated, and every workflow invocation would print the warning into AI-driven runs. Respec as the verb-first top-level `orbit fingerprint <change-name>` (pattern: `orbit validate <name>`, `orbit archive <name>`). Ripple to every citation: specs/orbit-base-fingerprints/spec.md (8), specs/orbit-archive-modifications/spec.md (1), design.md D3/D7 (3), proposal.md (4), tasks.md 2.1/4.2/5.2 (3).

findings.title: Guard requirement omits engine behavior for the `missing` status
findings.recommendation: The check-status set defines `missing` (touched requirement absent from the live baseline — e.g. a sibling renamed or removed it), and design.md's Risks section notes the existing hard error covers it, but the 'Archive-time divergence guard' requirement itself only specifies diverged/unverified/idempotent/verified. State normatively that `missing` defers to the spec-apply engine's existing not-found hard errors (MODIFIED/REMOVED target absent → abort), with one scenario, so implementers don't invent a new lenient path.

findings.title: Metadata requirement covers field-absent but not file-absent `.openspec.yaml`
findings.recommendation: The 'Metadata without fingerprints stays valid' scenario covers a `.openspec.yaml` containing only {schema, created}; it does not cover the metadata file being absent entirely (readChangeMetadata returns null). Broaden the scenario WHEN (or add one) so both absences yield the same all-unverified treatment.

findings.title: Mixed diverged+unverified prompt disclosure unstated
findings.recommendation: When both `diverged` and `unverified` requirements exist, only the divergence prompt fires; the run-summary scenario records both, but the prompt requirement doesn't say the divergence prompt must also disclose the unverified requirements. Add a clause: the divergence prompt lists unverified requirements alongside the diff.

findings.title: CLI-direct override leaves no visible record outside the workflow
findings.recommendation: Run summaries are workflow-written; a direct `orbit archive --override-fingerprints` records nothing (parity with gate_overridden, which is also workflow-recorded). Cheap hardening: require the engine to print a console notice naming each overridden requirement when the override flag is exercised, so the deliberate-loss act is visible in terminal/CI logs.

findings.title: D3 closing sentence garbles the no-heavy-command point
findings.recommendation: "Idempotent stamp = the D-c2-5 're-run over the touched specs'; no separate `--refresh`-style heavy command" is confusing since --refresh IS a flag this design defines. Reword to: no heavy new reconcile command (e.g. /orbit:rebase) is introduced; re-running the stamp (with --refresh) is the re-stamp vehicle.
